start: A release was just replaced by a newer one

steps.action: Open the app within 10 minutes of the new release
user_sees: The update screen; its lines may still be the previous release's for up to 10 minutes
must_not: Lines of one version shown under another version's number

steps.action: Open the app again after 10 minutes
user_sees: The new release's lines
must_not: Old lines kept for longer than 10 minutes

start: GET /app/whats-new.json with nothing in the 10-minute cache

steps.action: Ask GitHub's release API for the latest release's whats-new.json
user_sees: 200 with {"version":"x.y.z","lines":[...]}
Cache-Control max-age=600

steps.action: Ask again within 10 minutes
user_sees: The cached copy, without a GitHub call
must_not: A call to GitHub on every request

start: Both GitHub doors fail and no kept copy exists

steps.action: GET /app/whats-new.json
user_sees: 503 {"error":"not available"} with no-store

start: GitHub fails; a copy from the last 7 days is kept

steps.action: GET /app/whats-new.json
user_sees: 200 with the kept copy, max-age 60
must_not: A 503 while a good copy is kept
The kept copy cached for 10 minutes

user_sees: The full-screen 'A new MettleUp is here'

steps.action: On the old version, do "What's new notes for the app's update screen, served from MettleUp's own address" up to step 1; update the app; open it and carry on.
user_sees: The journey carries on or starts again cleanly, with nothing lost that was saved
must_not: A crash on first open, a lost or half-saved saved data, or a step that the new version no longer understands

note: the screen is shown exactly when an update is waiting

user_sees: The text wraps or is cut with dots; every button can still be reached
must_not: Text over other text, a button pushed off the screen, or the saved data saved with its text cut without a word to the user

note: at most 5 lines are served; a release with an empty list must not show an empty card
